meta_description: R.J Plastering & Rendering specialise in quality plastering and rendering across Sheffield and Rotherham. Free quotes, fast turnaround. Call today.
hero_eyebrow: Expert Plasterer — Smooth Finishes, Fast Turnaround
hero_subhead: From damp patches to full room renovations, we deliver flawless plaster finishes on time and on budget.
services_heading: Complete Plastering & Rendering Services Across Sheffield
services_subhead: Whether it's interior finishing, external rendering, or specialist repairs, we handle every plastering job with precision and care.

services.title: Interior Plastering
services.desc: Full wall and ceiling plaster skimming for a smooth, professional finish. Perfect for new builds, renovations, or damaged walls. We leave surfaces paint-ready.

services.title: External Rendering
services.desc: Weather-resistant cement and acrylic renders to protect and beautify your home's exterior. Improves insulation and kerb appeal in one job.

services.title: Artex Removal & Replacement
services.desc: Safe removal of textured ceilings with dust containment, followed by smooth plaster skimming. Transforms dated rooms instantly.

services.title: Damp Wall Repair
services.desc: Identify moisture sources and apply specialist plaster to prevent future damage. We work with surveyors' reports to get the fix right.

services.title: Plasterboard Installation & Taping
services.desc: Stud walls, partition frames, and ceiling boards installed to building regs, with full joint taping and finishing.

services.title: Patch & Repair Work
services.desc: Small cracks, holes, and blemishes repaired to match existing finishes. No job too small, competitive rates on quick fixes.

about_pullquote: Plasterers are only as good as their finish — we won't leave until it's perfect.
about_para_1: R.J Plastering & Rendering was founded over a decade ago by plasterers who'd seen too many shoddy finishes and rushed jobs. We built the business on one principle: take time to prep properly, and the plaster will reward you. Today we're trusted by homeowners, landlords, and builders across Sheffield and Rotherham for interior and external work.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on showing up on time, delivering exactly what we've quoted, and standing behind our work. Most of our jobs come from repeat customers and word-of-mouth referrals — that's because we treat every wall like it's our own home. We're clean, professional, and happy to explain what we're doing as we go.
reviews_heading: What Sheffield Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Brilliant job on our lounge. RJ came round, gave us a fair price straightaway, and turned up bang on time. The plaster finish is immaculate — smooth as anything. Really tidy worker too. Wouldn't hesitate to use again.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Had a damp problem on our back wall for months. RJ identified the issue, sorted the moisture, and replastered beautifully. He explained everything as he went and even gave us tips on ventilation. Fantastic service.
reviews.author: Sarah W.

reviews.text: Removed our Artex and reskinned the whole ceiling. Looked like a proper pro job — no dust mess, quick turnaround, and a flawless finish. Highly recommend. Fair prices too.
reviews.author: David M.
